output.reason: Evidence supports that earlier RBI pre-payment/foreclosure-charge directions are no longer in force (RBI (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 repealed effective 2025-11-28; the 2014 circular on levy of foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty withdrawn/repealed effective 2026-01-01). However, the evidence does not establish that a specific “3% pre-payment fee” appears in the copy, nor does it show that this non-compliance is specifically against RBI’s current rules (it only states, via UCB RBC Directions para 261(1), that a prepayment charge is “not permitted” for the described case).
